description: Angular component for editing and viewing SCADA symbols, including zoom, content management, and hidden element toggling.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolEditorComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component class for SCADA symbol editing interface.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form control state and subscribes to content changes.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up callbacks and initializes the SCADA symbol editing object.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updating content or read-only state.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys the editing object.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns current content based on editor mode.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Retrieves tags from the current content.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Zooms out of the symbol view.

methods.name: updateEditorMode
methods.description: Switches between SVG and XML editing modes.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Updates the symbol content, removing metadata.

methods.name: updateEditObjectContent
methods.description: Sets content in the editing object and updates zoom state.

methods.name: updateZoomButtonsState
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of zoom buttons.
